## Side-by-side R and Python

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```{r}
#| label: fit-r
library(fixest)
fit <- feols(mpg ~ wt | cyl, data = mtcars, cluster = ~cyl)
etable(fit)
```

## Python

```{python}
#| label: fit-py
import pyfixest as pf
from pyfixest.utils import get_data

fit = pf.feols("Y ~ X1 | f1", data=get_data(), vcov={"CRV1": "f1"})
fit.summary()
```

:::

`group="language"` keeps every R/Python tabset on the page in sync when the reader switches.

## Interactive: hand data to Observable

Pass a small, aggregated data frame from R or Python to OJS:

```{r}
#| label: to-ojs
#| echo: false
summary_tbl <- aggregate(mpg ~ cyl, data = mtcars, FUN = mean)
ojs_define(summary_tbl = summary_tbl)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof cyl = Inputs.radio([4, 6, 8], {label: "Cylinders", value: 4})
row = transpose(summary_tbl).find(d => d.cyl === cyl)
md`Average MPG: **${row.mpg.toFixed(1)}**`
```

For larger data, write an aggregated CSV next to the page, list it in
`scripts/published-data.txt`, and read it with
`FileAttachment("data/summary.csv").csv({typed: true})`.
